summary: Emanuel County fire tower that the statewide list says moved to Flat Creek Lodge; a 2007 article places it there, and no source describes it there today.

facts.agency: Georgia Forestry Commission (per the Eastern US Lookouts Georgia list)
facts.status_note: Moved from the Oak Park site to Flat Creek Lodge; a 2007 article places it at the lodge and no source confirms it stands there today.

access.note: On the grounds of a lodge that takes bookings. No source describes public access to the tower.

visit.trail_note: Ask the lodge before any visit. No source describes the tower or the original Oak Park site today.

events.note: By 2007 the tower was at Flat Creek Lodge, per the Georgia Trend article. The statewide list marks it as moved from Oak Park; no move date is given.

notes_for_editor: The move from Oak Park to Flat Creek Lodge rests on the statewide list entry and one 2007 Georgia Trend article. No source gives the move date or confirms the tower stands at the lodge now. A search snippet titled a Yelp listing for the lodge 'CLOSED - Updated September 2026', but Yelp returned HTTP 403 on fetch and the snippet is not cited; a human should call the lodge before anyone plans a visit. Brief status 'unknown' updated to relocated. Brief's coordinates, elevation (72.2 m = 237 ft) and gfc-111 tag match the list. The Eastern US Lookouts page does not say who runs it, so 'fan-run' was dropped from the story. The lodge site, fetched 2026-10-21, shows no closure notice; the Yelp CLOSED snippet is still unverified.
